sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, postclypeus paler; pronotum brown, meso- and metanotum paler; sternites (male) concolorous with the tergites; femora and tibiae brown, tarsi pale; wings tinged with brown, the subcostal streak brownish yellow. Head with only a few setae; pronotum more densely hairy; abdominal tergites densely hairy; wings densely covered with short setae. Head broadly oval, narrowed anteriorly; fontanelle very narrow, slit-like; head sutures faintly visible; compound eyes medium-sized, strongly projecting; distance between ocellus and compound eye equal to the short diameter of the ocellus, the inner margin of the ocellus strongly raised; frons with a rather deep depression; postclypeus short (though not very short), rather strongly raised; antenna 15-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length. Pronotum small, strongly narrowed posteriorly, anterior margin not concave; posterior margins of meso- and metanotum widely concave, with obtusely rounded projections; media with 2—3 branches, cubitus with 8—10 branches.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Blackish brown, the nasus black, head slightly darker than the rest of the body, paler around the antennae, tarsi tinged with yellow. Head and dorsum of body hairless. Head in dorsal view rounded-triangular; nasus long, conical, rather broad at the base; the frontal outline behind the base of the nasus strongly depressed; antenna 14-segmented, segment 3 less than twice as long as segment 2, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3. Pronotum small, anterior margin not concave.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head brown, dorsum of body pale brown, venter yellowish brown; tibiae slightly paler than the femora, tarsi tinged with yellow. Head with a few short setae, the posterior margin of the abdominal tergites with a row of short setae. Head slightly pentagonal and rounded; head sutures very distinct; fontanelle distinct, elongate; postclypeus very short; antenna 15-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length; pronotum short, saddle-shaped, anterior margin not concave.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Measurements (mm). Alate: body length with wings 15, body length without wings 8—9, fore wing length 12, head width 1.62, pronotum width 1.29, length 0.76. Soldier: body length 4.5, head length including nasus 1.80, head length (without nasus) 0.87, head width 1.14, pronotum width 0.57. Worker: body length 4—4.5, pronotum width 0.65. Distribution: Bukit Timah, Borneo; Java.

note: Adapted from the species-level description by Holmgren (1913c), original in German; alate, soldier and worker are all described and measured. Two figures, the head length of the alate and the head width of the worker, are damaged in the scanned text and have not been entered; the remaining figures are as in the original. The original description of the species is in Holmgren (1912a); this entry follows the 1913c monograph.
